tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List configured data sources with their types.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all queryable tables with their fully-qualified relation names.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show columns and types for one relation (e.g. 'crm.customers').

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query and return rows. Use fully-qualified relation names. Prefer LIMIT for exploration.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: List certified metrics — name, what each computes, its dimensions, and whether it supports a time grain. Prefer query_metric over writing SQL when a metric matches the question.

tools.name: query_metric
tools.description: Run a certified metric by name and return its governed result. Optionally group by dimensions (`by`) and/or a time grain.
